rationale: All 11 feasible runs are setup-limited at ss/100C/1.60V max-RC by a port path; hold sits at +0.1 ns, slew/cap pins are 0 (bar 0), DRC converges, wires match estimates. T_eff ~ 0.2*target + d, so period stays at the 0.45 floor; DELAY 3 reg-to-reg (4.24-4.37 ns) stays under d/0.8 ~ 4.8 ns for tight re-runs. Margins, RC model and cap% leave d unchanged here, but with timing-driven placement d grows with utilisation (21: 3.848, 22: 3.857, 25: 3.936, 30: 4.288). Keep the proven core (DELAY 3, timing-driven, no routability, post-GRT timing off (on in 2 of 3 failures), post-GRT design repair, slew 30), try util 20; TPE varies density, sizing, buffering.
